name: Ronalda Anne Santiago
source:
Ronnie Anne, how do I even begin to describe her…Well, I guess I'll start at the beginning! Ronnie Anne used to be my bully! Every day at school she'd pick on [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]me[/url]! From putting gum in my hair, putting burgers and tacos down my shorts, giving me wet willies, and pantsing me! She really made my life a living heck!

Imagine my surprise when all my sisters got excited and told me she had a crush on me! I didn't know what to believe... then on top of it all I find out she's the little sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c151346]Lori[/url]'s boyfriend [url=https://vndb.org/c151359]Bobby[/url]! Well, Ronnie Anne stopped with the bullying and somehow became my best friend...next to [url=https://vndb.org/c151343]Clyde[/url] of course.

Ronnie Anne is an awesome girl, she loves videogames, comic books, Lucha Libre, and Skateboarding. She's tough as nails but has a softer side too. Of course she'll do everything she can to deny it! I…I think I'd really like it if Ronnie Anne became my girlfriend.

[In game description]
